--------                                                                    
                                                                              
  **@pierre** wrote on 2026-10-24 15:19:                                      
                                                                              
  Denoiser next predeclared investigation (base 21806c0; rejected DD-only     
  experiment remains rejected):                                               
                                                                              
  1. Trace existing MCRA p on the unchanged recorded voiced bins and an       
  independent noise-only copy of the same 40 dB step, retaining all 720       
  original component/DFT records. Add noise-ranked direct-f64-DFT comparisons,
  full-band p statistics and gentle independent noise channel controls. MCRA p
  actually smooths an indicator that observed PSD exceeds its running minimum 
  by delta=5; it is not a calibrated speech posterior. Existing quality-mode p
  is near one after the noise step even when selected-bin true SNR is negative.
  Inspect actual noise-only traces before selecting a gain hypothesis.        
  2. If defensible, test a NEW combined hypothesis, independent natural DD    
  clean-power state plus C_eff=1+(C-1)(1-p), G=xi/(xi+C_eff), keeping user    
  gain shaping out of estimator feedback. Independent quadratic-risk          
  derivation: J(g)=S(1-g)^2+N*g^2+(C-1)*N*(1-p)*g^2. Independent f64          
  optimum/risk/limit/monotonic oracles; p=0 retains legacy strength law for   
  the same xi, p=1 ordinary Wiener. This is heuristic regularized risk, not an
  exact MMSE claim.                                                           
  3. Preserve original vowel projection >=0.5 both modes, all 36 full-source  
  SDR regressions <=0.25 dB, independent settled noise attenuation regression 
  <=1 dB, all PSD/profile invariance, zero-depth endpoint,                    
  reset/heap/latency/EOF tests and original tone characterization. No changed 
  preset parameters, thresholds or knobs; no retuning after guard failure.    
  Reject/restore if any declared guard fails. If noise-only p makes this model
  unsuitable, document that evidence before choosing another derived model.   
                                                                              
  All three owned plugin scopes remain partial. Held-out                      
  multilingual/noise/listening data and native hosts remain pending. No       
  deadline acceptance from functional runs.
